app_info.subtitle: Search live data and charts
app_info.description: Tako helps users find current data and metrics from proprietary datasets and the live web as citation-backed charts, retrieve the underlying result content, check available data coverage, answer multi-step research, company, and registry-officer questions with Tako's agents, and create shareable public chart links from user-provided structured data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches Tako's data index and the live web and returns matching cards and links; it modifies no record and no external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches the live public web on every call, a system outside Tako's first-party context; it only reads from it and publishes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only: deletes, overwrites, sends, and publishes nothing, so there is no outcome to undo.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same search returns results and changes nothing; no additional effect on any state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches the text of a supplied web page or the data rows of a Tako card and modifies neither.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches arbitrary public web pages that a search returned, systems outside Tako's first-party context; it only reads them and never submits or posts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only: deletes, overwrites, sends, and publishes nothing, so there is no outcome to undo.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same fetch returns the same content and changes nothing; no additional effect on any state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up Tako's structured-data coverage for an entity or metric and returns matching names without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Tako's own data graph and nothing else: no web request, no third-party system, and no publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only: deletes, overwrites, sends, and publishes nothing, so there is no outcome to undo.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same coverage lookup returns the same catalog answer and changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new Tako chart card, a durable resource with its own URL, from data the user supplied.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes a card that anyone with the URL can open without signing in, outside the current user's private context.
justifications.destructive_justification: The card is public and permanent: nothing in this app or in the Tako API deletes it, so a call can't be undone. Safeguards: the call only adds a card and never modifies or deletes existing data, and the tool description instructs the model to confirm with the user before it calls.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Each call mints a new persistent chart card with its own public URL; repeating the call creates another card.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the related nodes of one Tako data-graph node (its metrics, covered entities, competitors, memberships, sources) without modifying any record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Tako's own data graph and nothing else: no web request, no third-party system, and no publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only: deletes, overwrites, sends, and publishes nothing, so there is no outcome to undo.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same lookup returns the same related nodes and changes nothing; no additional effect on any state.

justifications.read_only_justification: A call with a query starts a queued agent run that the user can return to later by its run ID and thread ID. The run saves the charts and lists it builds as new Tako cards, each with its own URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: The run searches the live public web, a system outside Tako's first-party context. Anyone with the link can open the cards it saves, without signing in.
justifications.destructive_justification: A call adds a run and new cards. It deletes, overwrites, and sends nothing, and changes no existing record. The cards hold Tako and public web data, not data the user supplied, the same as the cards tako_search returns.
justifications.idempotent_justification: A call with a query starts and bills a new run, so repeating it repeats the work. A call with a run ID only waits on an existing run and repeats nothing; the tool description tells the model to resume with the run ID instead of sending the query again.

justifications.read_only_justification: A call with a query starts a queued agent run that the user can return to later by its run ID and thread ID. The run saves the charts and lists it builds as new Tako cards, each with its own URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: The run searches the live public web, a system outside Tako's first-party context. Anyone with the link can open the cards it saves, without signing in.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a company metric as structured data with a chart.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Tako, show me NVIDIA's quarterly revenue.
test_cases.expected_output: tako_search returns NVIDIA quarterly revenue with recent values, source attribution, and an inline chart card.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the underlying page text behind a web result URL as a post-search follow-up.
test_cases.user_prompt: I got this web result URL from a Tako search earlier: https://www.bls.gov/cpi/. Use Tako to fetch the full page text behind it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns readable page text from the supplied URL with enough context to use in a follow-up answer.

test_cases.description: Check which structured metrics Tako has on a company.
test_cases.user_prompt: What proprietary structured data does Tako have for Tesla?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns whether coverage exists, matching entities, and the exact available metric names for a follow-up search.

test_cases.description: Create a chart from data supplied directly by the user.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a public Tako bar chart titled Regional Sales using North America: 500, Europe: 300, and Asia: 450, with units of USD millions. I understand the card is public and permanent; go ahead and publish it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the Regional Sales bar chart, displays it inline as a Tako card, and gives the card's URL.

test_cases.description: Explore a company's competitors and coverage through the data graph.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Tako's data graph, which companies does NVIDIA compete with, and what metrics does Tako track for it?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists companies NVIDIA competes with and metrics Tako tracks for it, each with a count, from Tako's data graph. The model may resolve NVIDIA with tako_available_data first.

test_cases.description: Answer a multi-step research question with the Answer Agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Tako, rank the five largest US semiconductor companies by revenue growth over the last three fiscal years, and explain what drove the leader.
test_cases.expected_output: tako_agent returns a written answer with numbered citations and the chart cards it built. The reply ranks the companies, explains the leader's growth, and links each card's Tako page. If the first call returns status running, the model calls tako_agent again with the same run_id until the run finishes.

test_cases.description: Screen companies by registry facts with the Company Agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Tako, find active UK software companies incorporated in 2024 and registered in Manchester.
test_cases.expected_output: tako_company_agent returns a written answer with citations and a list card of matching companies. The reply summarizes the matches and links the card's Tako page, where the full list lives.

test_cases.description: Find a company's directors, with a run that outlasts one call.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Tako's company agent at high effort, who are the current directors of Dyson Technology Limited?
test_cases.expected_output: tako_company_agent starts a high-effort run and returns status running with a run_id; the model calls again with that run_id until the run finishes. If the model ends its turn first, it tells the user the run is still going, and when the user asks it to check again, it resumes the same run_id without starting a new run. The answer lists the company's current directors from the public company registry, with citations, and links the card's Tako page.

test_cases.description: Answer a single figure with search, not an agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Tako, what's Apple's market cap?
test_cases.expected_output: tako_search returns Apple's current market capitalization with source attribution and a chart card. Neither tako_agent nor tako_company_agent is called.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated creative-writing requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short bedtime story about a friendly lighthouse.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not involve data discovery, data retrieval, or visualization.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar-management requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my design team tomorrow at 10 AM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access or modify calendars.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending messages through another service.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email this market summary to my team.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send email or messages.
